events.verdict: Jones (CHI) establishes himself in Krejci's (ATL) path prior to the contact.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on White (CHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. While the ball is last touched by Chicago, Okongwu (ATL) jumps A to B into White and delivers contact that affects his shot.  Since the contact is proximate to the out of bounds, the initial out of bounds call was changed to a shooting foul on Okongwu after review.
White (CHI) and Alexander-Walker (ATL) come together at the same spot during the inbound, and the contact is marginal.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bulls.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) moves alongside White's (CHI) path as he defends the drive.
Giddey (CHI) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Krejci (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Jones' (CHI) path as he defends the shot attempt.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (defensive goaltending) was confirmed.  Krejci (ATL) blocks Jones' (CHI) shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Jones (CHI) moves alongside Young's (ATL) path as he defends the drive.
Young (ATL) moves alongside Giddey's (CHI) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Young (ATL) makes contact with Giddey's (CHI) arm as he is inbounding the ball.
Jones (CHI) establishes a wide screening position in Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path and contact occurs to his extended arm.
Okoro (CHI) and Krejci (ATL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Okongwu (ATL) initiates body to body contact with White (CHI) that dislodges him from his position.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) clamps and holds Vucevic's (CHI) arm and affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Okoro (CHI) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
Vucevic (CHI) moves alongside Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
White (CHI) falls to the floor on his own and not as a result of any contact from Risacher (ATL).
White (CHI) trips over his teammate Huerter's (CHI) foot during the inbound.
Risacher (ATL) commits a take foul on Vucevic (CHI).
